justifications.r1: Budget Dimir mana base with tapland friction.
justifications.r2: Stealing opponent creatures at end of turn fuels board presence.
justifications.a1: Horror typal redundancy with combat mill cards.
justifications.a2: Starts stealing milled threats on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p1: Presents cumulative combat mill damage on Turns 8–9.
justifications.p2: Requires 2–3 opponent untap steps to win through stolen creatures or mill.
justifications.i1: Counterspell, Pongify, and Dimir spot removal.
justifications.i2: Mesmeric Orb and mill taxes; no hard locks.
justifications.s1: Lightning Greaves and boots protect the Captain.
justifications.s2: Rebuilding relies on drawing fresh Horrors.
